implementation.title: Implement LongShortSpread class
implementation.description: Create synapse/backtest/spread.py with LongShortSpread class. Constructor accepts optional benchmark_returns Series. compute() takes quintile_returns DataFrame (columns Q1-Q5) and returns a frozen dataclass with spread_returns (Q5 - Q1), cumulative_spread, benchmark_returns, excess_returns, annual_spread_return, annual_benchmark_return, annual_excess_return. Handle missing benchmark gracefully (excess_returns = None when no benchmark).
modification_points: Implement compute() method: spread = Q5_return - Q1_return, cumulative = (1+spread).cumprod()-1
Compute excess returns: spread - benchmark when benchmark provided
Compute annualized benchmark and excess returns when benchmark available
logic_flow: Extract Q5 and Q1 columns from quintile_returns DataFrame
Compute spread_returns = Q5 - Q1 for each period
If benchmark provided: compute excess_returns = spread - benchmark
Compute annualized metrics for all return series
Return frozen dataclass with all results
